title: Vehicle Purchase Agreements — Conditions of Delivery
content:
A vehicle sold under the **Vehicle Purchase Agreements** is delivered on these conditions.

1. **Status.** A vehicle is delivered, whether by final delivery or by spot delivery, only from a deal in contracted status, as the deal's record shows.
2. **Delivery window.** The store delivers within the deal type's delivery window, in calendar days after the contract date. When it does not, the buyer's remedy is the late-delivery waiver of the buyer cancellation terms.
3. **Open safety recalls.** Where the deal type's recall block applies, a vehicle with an open safety recall campaign is not delivered until the remedy is performed. A campaign is open when it has no remedy-performed record in the warranty records. For deal types without the block, an open recall is disclosed to the buyer in writing and does not block delivery.
4. **Buyers Guide and coverage.** The Buyers Guide box checked for a used vehicle is the deal type's Buyers Guide warranty box. A Used Vehicle Retail Purchase is delivered with the store's Kessler Used Vehicle Limited Warranty, whose terms are those of the warranty charter. A Value Line Used Vehicle Purchase vehicle is sold as-is with no dealer warranty. Certified and new vehicles carry the manufacturer's coverages.
5. **Deposits at delivery.** On the delivery date every deposit held is applied to the deal, one application per deposit. Each applied deposit is credited to the deal as a payment.

## Recall check

| Deal type's recall block | Open recall without a remedy-performed record | Delivery |
|---|---|---|
| applies | yes | not delivered until the remedy is performed |
| applies | no | not blocked by this clause |
| does not apply | yes | delivered after written disclosure of the recall |

*Hypothetical:* a contracted deal holding two deposits of 1000.00 and 750.00 gets two applications on the delivery date, totalling 1750.00.
